the exclave gets its name (4 Oct 2026): Akṣata is the one polity made of two separate parts, and v2.0.1 named only its largest part, so the exclave inside Novalia stayed a nameless shape (reported from a phone at high zoom). Every part of a polity now carries the name, with its own label point, fit test and size class; 23 polities, 24 labels. Display only: no canon parameter, no data and no geometry changed; see [`INTERREGNA_V2_NOTES.md`](https://github.com/rizkidwisulistianto-web/rhykaris-map/blob/main/docs/INTERREGNA_V2_NOTES.md) §10
